suspension_passage.name: Seven places for a passage
suspension_passage.description: 49 retained fragments, seven raised. Compare a continuous passage with separate pockets, then exchange two height assignments. Original desktop study after Mona Hatoum's Remains to be Seen.
interactions: Use the supplied desktop viewer to select an arrangement
Walk through or around the field

parameters.exchange: swap_cells(first, second) exchanges unlike heights while retaining the count

suspension_passage.qfep_connection: Identical value counts and fixed horizontal addresses can offer different routes. Access also depends on the declared body, exposing a hidden assumption behind calling a space open.
suspension_passage.placement_note: Needs a clear walking perimeter beyond the display bounds; never occupy the only exit route.
suspension_passage.status: standalone chapter companion; not installed in the spine
suspension_passage.limits: Static kinematic placement, convex collision approximation, visual cables. No weight, damage, tension or original-debris history. Native desktop checks do not establish headset or learner acceptance.
